plot: On the coldest night of the winter everyone sleeps by the fire, and a huge snore keeps Max awake; everyone blames Dog, Max's earmuff plan lands him in the cold water bowl, then he finds Dog is quiet on his side and rolls him over with a cookie crumb, but the whistle goes on, and the real snorer is Grandma, the 'little tea kettle' her mama talked about, so Max lets her sleep, moves himself into the warm laundry basket, and in the morning learns Dog may run off-leash only if he comes back when called.

script.title: Who Snores on the Coldest Night

beats.say: What is that noise?! Is the whole house growling?
SNOOORE... wheeeee. SNOOORE... wheeeee.
It's the coldest night of the winter so far.
One hour ago, Grandma made cozy beds for everyone by the fire.
Blankets for Dog, a sock bed for Mouse, a pillow for me.
And a blanket for Max! Right next to me!
Max, sleep far away from Dog. Trust me.
Why? Dog is my best friend. And he's so warm!
Don't worry. I sleep like a quiet little mouse.
My mama called me her little tea kettle. I never knew why.
Grandma had a big day. Sledding, baking, and drying wet Dog.
Lights out. The fire crackles. Everyone closes their eyes.
And then...
SNOOORE... wheeeee.
Mouse! Psst! Mouse, are you awake?
Nobody can sleep through that. It sounds like a tractor.
It's Dog. It has to be Dog. Look at his big nose.
Dog is fast asleep on his back, all four paws up high.
I told you. Sleep far away from Dog.
Then I won't hear it! I'll wear Grandma's earmuffs!
Max finds Grandma's fluffy pink earmuffs on the sofa.
Much too big! They cover his ears, his eyes, his nose.
Ahh. Quiet. Perfectly, wonderfully quiet.
Max! Stop! You're walking right into Dog's water bowl!
What? I can't hear you, Mouse! It's so nice and quiet!
Splash! Max sits right down in the water bowl. Ice cold water.
Meeeow! Cold! Cold! Cold!
The earmuffs fly off. And the snore is still there.
SNOOORE... wheeeee.
Now I'm wet AND awake. This is the longest night ever.
If I don't sleep, I'll be too tired to play tomorrow!
Mouse, I'm going to look at that snore. Up close.
Max tiptoes over to Dog. Mouse rides on his tail.
SNOOORE...
Hear that? The SNOOORE part comes out of Dog's nose.
Then Dog wiggles in his sleep and rolls onto one side.
The growl stops. Just for a moment.
Did you see that? On his side, he's quiet!
And on his back, he's a tractor!
But Dog rolls back again. Paws up. SNOOORE.
Then we roll him over. Gently. On three.
One... two... Max! He's as heavy as the sofa!
Max pushes. Mouse pushes. Dog smiles in his sleep and doesn't move.
Mmm... more cookies, Grandma... mmm...
He's dreaming about cookies! That gives me an idea.
Max picks one cookie crumb out of his whiskers.
He holds it out, just beside Dog's sleeping nose.
Sniff. Sniff, sniff. And Dog rolls right over onto his side.
The growl is gone. Dog sleeps like a big, quiet loaf.
We did it, Mouse! Now we can finally sleep.
Max curls up. Mouse curls up. Everything is still.
Then...
Wheeeeeeee.
But Dog is quiet now! So who is whistling?
Maybe the wind? Maybe the fire?
Max follows the sound. Not to the fire. Not to the window.
To the big pillow next to the sofa.
Wheeeee... SNORT. Wheeeee... SNORT.
Grandma? But she sleeps like a quiet little mouse!
Her mama called her a tea kettle. Now I know why!
Do we roll Grandma over too?
No. Grandma worked so hard today. Let her sleep.
If the noise can't move, then I'll move.
Max tries the sofa. Wheeee. Too close.
He tries the window. Brrr. Too cold.
Then he finds Grandma's laundry basket, full of warm, soft towels.
Warm. Soft. And far, far away from the tea kettle.
Scoot over, Max. I'm coming in too.
And soon, the whole living room is fast asleep.
In the morning, the sun shines on the snow.
Good morning, my dears! I slept like a quiet little mouse!
Max and Mouse look at each other. Nobody says a word.
I slept great! Did anybody else hear a tractor?
Everyone laughs. Even Grandma.
Everybody makes funny noises in their sleep. And that's okay.
When the snow melts, Dog may run in the park, leash-free.
But only if he comes back every time we call him.
Dog? Come back? He never comes back! He chases everything!

long.title: Who Snores on the Coldest Night? 😴
long.description:
"It was the coldest night of the year, and I could not sleep for one minute." 🐱
Everyone sleeps by the warm fire, but a giant SNORE... wheeee keeps Max awake. Everybody thinks it's Dog. Max goes to find out. Max the Curious Cat, Ep 37.
